slides.headline: See Beyond The Stars
slides.description: Title slide: kicker label, headline text, and a thin accent line on a dark gradient background. No bullet list, diagram, or chart is shown.
bullets: Turn scattered reviews into structured guest intelligence
Reveal what truly drives Bangkok fine dining satisfaction
Replace gut feeling with evidence-based operational decisions
slides.narration: Thousands of reviews contain the answers, but star ratings hide the detail. This platform turns fragmented guest feedback into clear, actionable intelligence for Bangkok’s fine dining operators.

slides.headline: One Voice, Many Languages
slides.description: Editorial slide: kicker label, headline, and a bordered box containing the slide's bullet points as the on-screen text.
bullets: Collect 15,000 to 30,000 reviews across 30 to 50 restaurants
Clean multilingual feedback for consistent analysis
Classify sentiment across every meaningful guest experience aspect
slides.narration: We build a scalable AI research pipeline, gathering and preparing reviews across Bangkok’s fine dining market, then translating complex feedback into consistent, comparable insight.

slides.headline: Benchmark What Matters
slides.description: Illustrated pipeline diagram: kicker, headline, and numbered circular stages connected by downward arrows, each labeled with a step of the process.
bullets: Rank restaurants with an aspect-based AI Restaurant Score
Compare food, service, atmosphere, value, and more
Map operational excellence against guest experience
slides.narration: The result goes beyond aggregate ratings. Operators can see how they compare across the categories that shape loyalty, reputation, and the complete dining experience.

slides.headline: Find The Moments That Matter
slides.description: Scorecard slide: kicker, headline, and a bordered box listing label/value stat rows summarizing the project's real scope.
bullets: Trace sentiment from reservation through payment
Identify recurring praise, complaints, and language themes
Track performance shifts over time and after changes
slides.narration: Customer journey mapping shows exactly where sentiment rises or falls, while trend and theme analysis reveal recurring issues and whether improvements are actually working.

slides.headline: Turn Insight Into Action
slides.description: Closing slide: kicker label and headline on a dark gradient background, matching the opening slide's style. No bullet list, diagram, or chart is shown.
bullets: Highlight each restaurant’s strengths, weaknesses, and quick wins
Deliver a clear one-page benchmark report
slides.narration: Every restaurant receives a practical action plan: its market position, biggest opportunities, competitive context, and the next improvements most likely to create guest value.
